couple.message: We met on a trek neither of us was fit enough for, and we have been walking side by side ever since. These hills gave us our first chapter, so we are bringing the people we love back here for the next one. Come for the rituals, stay for the dancing, and bring shoes you can climb in.

guestInfo.title: Weather
guestInfo.text: Expect 24°C by day and 11°C after sunset. Pack a warm layer for the evening events.

guestInfo.title: Staff accommodation
guestInfo.text: Rooms for drivers and nannies are booked at Hill View Lodge, 400 metres from the main gate.

guestInfo.title: Parking
guestInfo.text: Free valet at the main gate. Self-parking is at the lower lot, with a shuttle up to the hotel.
